name: spreadsheetSetRepeatingRows
description: Sets the print-title rows of the active sheet in a spreadsheet workbook, so the given row range repeats at the top of every printed page. The range is an A1 address such as "1:1" or "1:3". Implemented via the _xlnm.Print_Titles defined name. The fluent member form is setRepeatingRows(rows).

params.name: rows
params.description: A1 address of the row range to repeat on every printed page, e.g. "1:1".

examples.title: Repeat a header row when printing
examples.description: Row 1 repeats at the top of every printed page.
